cohort: 26 patients with a genetically confirmed diagnosis of Vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (vEDS) who were referred for outpatient consultation at the Brescia University Hospital between January 2011 and July 2023.
finding: Despite high rates of celiprolol use and good tolerability, the yearly risk of symptomatic vascular events in the cohort remained nonnegligible at 8.8%, with most events occurring after reaching the maximum recommended dose.
